HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 7th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96/BENCH: it is hereby informed to all the learned members
of the Bar and litigants that Hon’ble The Chief Justice is pleased to make the following
roster/determination, (in supersession of all earlier notifications in this regard) to deal with
subjects given in the table below with effect from 10.08.2026 (Monday) :-

Note: C
1. All Contempt Cases will be placed- before the Hon'ble Single Bench or Division Bench
which passed the order out of which the contempt arises.
2. In Contempt Cases arising out of orders passed by a Single Judge, if the Hon'bre Single
Judge is not in office owing to retirement/elevation/transfer/or any other reason, the
matter will be placed before the Hon’ble Chief Justice on .the administrative side for
assIgnIng.
3. Contempt petitions arising out of the orders made by a Division Bench (other than a
Division Bench of HMJ A. Bimol Singh and HMJ A. Guneshwar Sharma) shall be placed
before the Hon’ble Chief Justice’s Bench with the Hon’ble Judge who is a party in the
Division Bench which made the order out of which the Contempt arises. If both the
Hon’ble Judges who made the order are not available, the Contempt Case will be listed
before the Hon’ble Chief Justice’s Division Bench, including suo motu Cases.
4. All matters reserved for Judgment/Orders, part heard matters and particularly
assigned matters including Election Petitions shall continue to be heard/dealt by the
same Bench.
5. Matters may also be listed before any Bench as per the order of the Hon’ble (-hief
